name: Model Context Protocol (MCP), core specification
status: Specification version 2026-07-28 (the latest release is 2026-07-28; the specification directory holds 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25, 2026-07-28 and a draft; no later release, read 2026-11-23); the blog post of 2025-12-09 says "Anthropic is donating MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation". The maintainers' blog of 2026-11-11 moves specification releases to the last Tuesday of March and September, the next targeted for 2027-03-30; the Events extension (SEP-3415, merged on 2026-11-19 with the label "final") lets a client subscribe to events in an upstream system so that an agent can react "without the user being present", and an extension for file uploads and downloads was described as an experimental draft on 2026-11-10 (read 2026-11-23).
relevance: The specification describes MCP as "an open protocol that enables seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools"; discovery is in mcp-server-card and lf-ai-catalog.

committed_next.what: Next specification release, MCP version 2027-03-30, targeted by the maintainers in the release-cycle post of 2026-11-11.
